Jemen
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Ryadh, Saudi Arabia
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Beograd
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Republic of Yemen are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Ryadh, Saudi Arabia.
